name: Feature Delivery
description: Produce a narrow implementation artifact through one shell-backed runtime task.

name: Optional Delivery
description: Produce a narrow implementation artifact with advisory auto review that never blocks the execution terminal state.

name: Research Spike
description: Capture a narrow research artifact with conservative execution and manual review preference.

name: Advisory Delivery
description: Produce a narrow implementation artifact with auto review, escalating to human review only if the automated gate fails.

name: Guarded Delivery
description: Produce a narrow implementation artifact with auto review evidence plus mandatory human sign-off.

name: Research Spike Reviewable
description: Run a review-heavy research spike through the experimental borrowed agent and durable pilot lanes.

name: Project Delivery
description: Drive a planner to parallel coder and researcher workers, then collect reviewer evidence for a complex project slice.

name: Guarded Project Delivery
description: Drive the multi-role project-delivery orchestration through the same shared graph substrate while keeping the review path on mandatory human sign-off.
